Mr Miliband's remarks come after the Scottish First Minister Nicola Sturgeon said Labour could only govern with the support of the SNP. SNP and Labour manifestos both commit to re-introducing the 50p top rate of tax, scrapping the bedroom tax and beefing up the energy regulator. Ms Sturgeon also pledged to help Labour reduce tuition fees by £3,000 to £6,000 a year – even though Scotland has already scrapped student fees. But at least one big stumbling block remains to a deal between the two parties – Britain's nuclear deterrent.

Primatologists at Iowa State University recorded 300 hunts by chimps in Fongoli, Sénégal, and found female chimps were using tools to capture prey in 60 per cent of the observations. However, the male chimpanzees tended to capture larger prey and used their hands. The study suggests that early female humans were perhaps the first to begin fashioning simple tools to help them catch prey. It has been known that chimpanzees use tools like humans for more than 50 years.
